question: What is the meaning of reversible structures in relation to process?
description: Reversible building design (or circular design) is a design and construction strategy to provide products (or buildings) that can easily be deconstructed, or where parts can be removed and added easily without damaging the product (or building), with components or materials (Durmi sevic et al. 2018). This strategy enables products or buildings to be easily adapted, transformed and disassembled, which helps to maintain a product’s value to encourage reuse, reduces risks for second life options and enables the closing of material loops.
